snippet.title: [Danganronpa: Hope Restoration] Prologue (Full)
snippet.description:
Look! It's the prologue, at long last!☆ 

Download the game here: https://gamejolt.com/games/DRHR/453108
---

Thank you to everyone who viewed and commented on the trailers and joined the discord server, it's a big part of what motivated me to keep working on this and do my best! Even bigger thank you to the voice actors for assisting me with this project, I love you so much and I can't express just how thankful I am for your help, (´∀｀)♡☆
